steps.script:
set -u
export GIT_TERMINAL_PROMPT=0
export PATH="/opt/venv/bin:/usr/local/sbin:/usr/local/bin:/usr/sbin:/usr/bin:/sbin:/bin"
__rx() { awk '/:/ {sub(/^ */, ""); split($0, a, ":"); if (a[1] != "lo") {split(a[2], b, " "); s += b[1]}} END {print s + 0}' /proc/net/dev; }
__rx_before=$(__rx)
__start=$(date +%s%N)
sudo -u user -H --preserve-env env PATH="$PATH" bash -c '{param:command}'
__rc=$?
__end=$(date +%s%N)
__rx_after=$(__rx)
awk -v s="$__start" -v e="$__end" -v b="$__rx_before" -v a="$__rx_after" -v rc="$__rc" 'BEGIN { printf "bench-install runtime_ms=%.3f rx_bytes=%d exit_code=%d\n", (e - s) / 1e6, a - b, rc }'
exit "$__rc"
